* Dimensions are evaluated strictly by the integrated computer vision service. NetraProof does not simulate artificial scores in the absence of an authoritative model.
Clinical capture criteria for optimal diagnostic fidelity:
Ensure Retinal Focus: Retinal vascular bifurcations and optic nerve margins must be sharp and distinct.
Avoid Reflections & Glare: Adjust angle to eliminate bright corneal crescent glares obscuring the macula.
Capture Complete Field: Align camera so both the optic disc and fovea centralis are clearly within the visual frame.
Prevent Eyelash Obstruction: Ask patient to open eyes wide; avoid blinking or eyelid occlusion during capture.
Model A: DR Severity Prediction (EfficientNet-B0 Ensemble)
5-fold cross-validated ensemble executing ordinal regression across Grades 0 through 4.
Spatial segmentation of microaneurysms, hemorrhages, hard exudates, and cotton wool spots.

Quality Gate Policy: Downstream models are locked until this optical quality assessment stage passes. The quality gate prevents noisy, out-of-focus, or artifact-heavy images from generating false positive diagnostic reports.

Clinical Safety Notice: Image quality assessment evaluates whether the uploaded retinal image meets the configured technical requirements for further screening. It does not diagnose diabetic retinopathy or guarantee clinical suitability. Good image quality does not indicate healthy eyes, and poor quality does not indicate retinopathy.
